### Borea v0.5.2

A patch release with Simplified Chinese and a few fixes. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Simplified Chinese

Borea is now available in Simplified Chinese. Choose it in Settings > General > Language.
The whole translation, all of its about 1,500 texts, is by @kuxiaowo, who also translated the README on GitHub. Thank you, and welcome!

Settings > About now lists the translators of every language.

#### Fixes

- A setting that Borea could not save, for example because the file was locked for a moment, is no longer lost: Borea saves it with the next change.
- One broken text in the content index no longer stops Borea from reading the whole index. Only the entry with that text is skipped.
- Page and download links of a SpaceDock mod always lead to SpaceDock. A release whose download would lead to another site is skipped.
- A mod that the content index delisted no longer shows from SpaceDock instead.
- When a mod stops the game on Linux, Borea now also names it when its folder name differs from the mod id in upper and lower case.
- When Borea compares a mod you installed by hand with a release from the index, it removes its unpacked copy also when it cannot delete the download.
- When you leave a page while another page loads the same listing data, the other page no longer fails to load it.
- When the content index cannot be read, the message now names the reason.

#### Good to know

- On Linux, Chinese text needs a font with Chinese characters, such as Noto Sans CJK (`fonts-noto-cjk` on Debian and Ubuntu). Most desktops that are set up for Chinese already have one.
- This version is tested with KSA 2026.10.19.5638.
- Borea is a community project by the KSA Modding team. It is not made by RocketWerkz.
